title: Anisotropic drag force in finite-density QGP from charged rotating 5D black holes
summary: We study the drag force acting on a heavy quark in a holographic plasma with rotational anisotropy and finite density. The bulk dual is the CCLP black hole of five-dimensional minimal gauged supergravity, characterised by two independent rotation parameters and electric charge. In the neutral Kerr--AdS limit, we use the principal Killing string to obtain an exact drag force for arbitrary rotation parameters.
